Key participants: Jake Heier (sales?), Jeremy (Growthbook technical lead), Ágata Marinho (organizer, from customer side), Thiago Cunha Cunha, Osf Soares, Grein Augusto (developer team from customer side). Product: GrowthBook (feature flagging/experimentation platform). Pain points: SDK conflicts with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Rhino environment), cache/flickering issues, need server-side rendering but SDK not compatible. Discussed alternative: fetch payload from CDN on server, embed JSON in page, use client-side SDK without network request. Also discussed metrics/data sources (managed warehouse vs external). Next steps: customer team will test implementation; need data-side person for follow-up call; Jake to resend Teams channel invites and provide trial license key. 

Summary: The call with GrowthBook (Jake Heier, Jeremy) and Ágata Marinho's team (Thiago, Osf, Grein) focused on SDK compatibility issues with Salesforce Commerce Cloud due to Rhino backend limitations. They proposed a workaround using server-side CDN payload fetching combined with a client-side SDK to avoid flicker and caching problems.
